import griffe

# Load the package "mypkg" as it existed at tag "v1.0.0"
old = griffe.load_git("mypkg", ref="v1.0.0", repo=".")

# Load the package "mypkg" as it currently exists at HEAD
new = griffe.load_git("mypkg", ref="HEAD", repo=".")

# Detect and print each API breakage between the two versions
for breakage in griffe.find_breaking_changes(old, new):
